senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טָפַף I) [to join, add,]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:4">Kel. III, 4</cite> <he>וטְפָלָן בגללין</he> and lined them (the cracked vessels) with a paste of ordure.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>הטוֹפֵל וכ׳</he> if one covers with paste a sound vessel.

<cite ref="Beitzah 34a:9">Bets. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>אין טוֹפְלִין וכ׳</he> you must not cover (the fowls) with potter’s clay (to get the feathers off); <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:19">Tosef. ib. III, 19</cite> <he>וטובלין</he> ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Shabbat 80b:3">Sabb. 80ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 43a">Pes. 43ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:18">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>טוֹפְלוֹת אותן בסיד</he> dress their skins with lime (to keep them hairless).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:5">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> (in Chald. diction) <he>שחוק וטְפוֹל</he> grind it to powder and apply it (as a remedy); a. fr.
<cite ref="Chagigah 8a:2">Ḥag. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>בטוֹפֵל</he> when he combines two different funds.

<cite ref="Chagigah 8a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>טוֹפְלִין בהמה לבהמה וכ׳</he> you may use the second tithe money for buying an additional animal to that designated for the pilgrim’s offering (<cite ref="H00148"><he>חֲגִיגָה</he></cite>), but you must not join the two funds (in order to buy a larger animal).
Ab. Zar. 25ᵇ טוֹפְלוֹ לימינו lets the gentile walk to his right side, v. זָמַן; (Tosef. ib. III, 4 נותנו); Ḥull. 91ᵃ.—Part. pass. טָפוּל
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:2:2">Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᶜ</cite> bot. (ref. to Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:2">Sabb. XVI, 2</cite>) <he>בשאינו ט׳ לו וכ׳</he> when the casing is not attached to the book, but if it is &c.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:4:4">Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 4:6:3">Y. Peah IV, 18ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>טְפוּלִין לאביהן</he> dependent on (living with) their parents (cmp.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 12b">B. Mets. 12ᵇ</cite>, s. v. <cite ref="O01097"><he>סָמַךְ</he></cite>).
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6">Lev. R. s. 6</cite>; s. 15; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 281">Yalk. Is. 281</cite> <he>ונִטְפְּלוּ בישעיה</he> and they were embodied in the Book of Isaiah. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 17 <he>נִטְפַּלְתֶּם בעצמי</he> you will be attached to myself (be called sons of Jacob); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 161">Yalk. Gen. 161</cite>; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:1">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>זכיתם בעצמי</he> you will have a share in me).
<cite ref="Chullin 91a:15">Ḥull. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>ישראל שנ׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00535"><he>זָמַן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 65a:12">Men. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>ניט׳ להם וכ׳</he> R. J. joined their discussions.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 9a:4">Snh. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>הני׳ לעוברי עבירה</he> he who is an accessory to sin. Y. B. Kam. X, 7ᶜ top, <he>שלא … נִטְפָּלִין לגנבים</he> that citizens may not be in conspiracy with thieves (and sell the stolen goods to their owner under the pretence of having bought them).

senses.gloss: to attend to, to nurse, tend. Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ top מי שני׳ … יִטָּפֵל בי וכ׳ those who attended to me (nursed me) in life, shall attend to me in death; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top; Gen. R. s. 100; Tanḥ. Vayḥi 3.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Ib.</cite> a. e. <he>להִטָּפֵל בקבורתו</he> to attend to his funeral; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 10b">B. Kam. 10ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>הבעלים מִטַּפְּלִין וכ׳</he> the owner has to attend to the disposal of the carcass.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 28b:15">B. Mets. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מִטַּפֵּל בהן</he> must take care of them.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite>; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:11">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>אני בעצמי מט׳ וכ׳</he> I myself shall attend to thy burial; a. fr.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 80a:9">Kidd. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>ושרצים … מִיטַּפְּלִין שם</he> vermin and frogs breed in the house.

senses.gloss: (denom. of טָפֵל) burdened with a large family.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 16a">Taan. 16ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>מט׳ ואין לו</he> one having a large family with no means of support.
